revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art, app-facing raster asset
Primary request: Create one standalone watercolor travel journal achievement medal for the second travel tier. It should feel more visually prominent than the first travel medal, with stronger contrast between the warm paper medal base and the center objects.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Subject: circular paper medal base with handmade scalloped edge, delicate pencil outline, gentle cream paper texture, watercolor washes. Center elements: an ochre travel suitcase, a folded pale-blue map, a small red-orange route pin, and a curved dotted travel route. No animals and no people.
Style/medium: soft watercolor travel scrapbook, hand-painted, low-saturation TripPet palette, delicate pencil linework, cozy polished mobile game collectible.
Composition/framing: centered single medal, full object visible, generous padding around medal, square composition, readable at small 62pt UI size. Center objects should be clear, darker than the pale medal base, and not washed out.
Color palette: warm cream paper base, ochre suitcase, dusty blue map, muted sage leaves, small coral accent; avoid pure #00ff00 anywhere in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese text, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection. Do not create multiple medals; exactly one medal only. Keep subject fully separated from the flat green background with crisp edges.
